root_cause: Use of blended pricing instead of interchange‑plus causing higher fees.
diagnosis: The blended rate of 2.0% yields fees of Rs 144,140.57 versus the true network cost of Rs 130,294.86 (effective rate 1.81%), overcharging the merchant by Rs 13,845.71.
action_rationale: Switching to IC+ pricing aligns charges with the actual network cost, eliminating the overcharge.
